changes.description: An outline acquired from a published source or a file is kept in the payload store (IndexedDB) under areaRef, with its revisions, rather than in the saved workflow; the 1 MiB extent budget and the 1.5 MiB area budget, both sized for localStorage, are removed. A unit of several parts carries every part (Uganda at ADM0: 48, the islands of Lake Victoria among them), and a refusal is said in the dialog status line as well as under the unit list. Found when Uganda at ADM0 drew nothing. Experiment 121.

evidence.note: Repository regression coverage exists; this release entry does not certify a widget independently.
